# Final verification of all requirements from TASK:
# 1. Three milestones implemented in order (m1, m2, m3)
# 2. Each milestone has exactly one commit
# 3. All tests pass after each milestone
# 4. Only library source files changed (funcy/calc.py)

import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='/app/repo')
print("Git log (commits on top of base):")
print(result.stdout)

# Verify only calc.py was changed
result2 = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'base', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='/app/repo')
print("Files changed:")
print(result2.stdout)

# Run full test suite one final time
result3 = subprocess.run(['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-x', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', 
    'tests/test_calc.py', 'tests/test_colls.py', 'tests/test_debug.py', 
    'tests/test_decorators.py', 'tests/test_flow.py', 'tests/test_funcmakers.py',
    'tests/test_funcolls.py', 'tests/test_funcs.py', 'tests/test_interface.py',
    'tests/test_objects.py', 'tests/test_seqs.py', 'tests/test_strings.py',
    'tests/test_tree.py', 'tests/test_types.py'], 
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='/app/repo')
print("\nFinal test run:")
print(result3.stdout)
print(f"Exit code: {result3.returncode}")
